I farm a fairly large maize plot for my household, and because it is intercropped I try to manage costs carefully while still getting a better harvest. I will use some purchased inputs where I can, especially seed and a little fertilizer, but I cannot afford heavy use of chemicals. We depend a lot on our own family work, though for peak times like planting and weeding I will hire some labor.
